qualities.label: Auto
qualities.long: Smaller copies on integrated graphics, battery, no video decoder or under 8 GB; stills in power-saver. Video on the focused monitor only.

qualities.label: Full
qualities.long: As shipped, on every monitor: smoothest, and the most GPU, power and memory.

qualities.label: Eco
qualities.long: 1080p 30 fps copies, made once: ~¼ of the decoding, softer on big screens. Focused monitor only.

qualities.label: Still
qualities.long: First frame only: almost no GPU or power. Other animations still play.

saver.qualityLine: As shipped, every monitor · 4K theme: ~4% CPU, 1 GB.
saver.qualityLong: As shipped, on every monitor: smoothest, and the most GPU, power and memory.
saver.screenOffLockedNote: From the lock or last touch; any input wakes it

sleep.lockWithDarwanNote: Power menus and loginctl lock with your theme

saver.summary: screensaver after 5 min, locks 10 s later · screen off after 10 min · never suspends

timeline.note: For the first 10 s (amber), any key returns to the desktop.
